leadText:
Movie Panic (Japanese: VSバルチャイ VS ), titled VS Vullaby in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 530th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the sixth chapter of the .

It is subtitled Vullaby (Japanese: ムービーズ・パニック Movies Panic) in the VIZ Media translation and Movie Panic in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
